## Low-battery floor (PROVISIONAL, not locked)

Needed: CORE_3V3 >= 3.0 V at the load. In 100 % mode CORE_3V3 = VIN - I x (R_HS + DCR + LINK_REG); VIN = VBAT(gauge) - I_SYS x (RON_BAT + LINK_BAT). The cell's own resistance is outside this: the gauge measures VBAT after it.

| R set | Event | I 3V3 (mA) | I SYS (mA) | VIN_REG min (V) | VBAT at gauge min (V) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| max R | worst-case event | 519 | 969 | 3.409 | 3.594 |
| max R | TX burst, no audio/haptics | 375 | 420 | 3.296 | 3.376 |
| typ R | worst-case event | 519 | 969 | 3.309 | 3.469 |
| typ R | TX burst, no audio/haptics | 375 | 420 | 3.224 | 3.293 |

- TPS62840 R_HS is specified only at VIN 3.6 V (430/600 mOhm); at 3.1-3.4 V it is higher [TEST at bring-up].

**Total: 31.4 uA typical** (target <= 35 uA), **65.3 uA worst stack** (hard limit <= 50 uA applies to the measured board). The worst stack puts every maximum, the allowances for the S3 and IMU (no published maximum) and 70 % light-load efficiency together; even with the S3 and IMU at typical it is ~53 uA. It is where the risk sits, not an expected value.
